meta.epoch_status: GHSL R2023A built-up epochs come from spatial-temporal interpolation of five observed image collections: Landsat (MSS, TM, ETM) supports 1975, 1990, 2000 and 2014, the Sentinel-2 composite (GHS-composite-S2 R2020A) supports 2018 (JRC Data Catalogue). Epochs between observations (1995, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020) are interpolated; 2025 (and 2030) are projections past the last observed epoch, not observations.
meta.b2025_status: in the R2023A release, but projected (not observed): interpolated/extrapolated past the last observed epoch (2018)
meta.grid: 0.01 deg (~1.1 x 1.1 km) cells over the AOI
meta.method: built_frac = GHSL built-up m2 (100 m pixels binned by centre) / cell area measured on the equal-area Mollweide plane (ESRI:54009); values clipped to 0-1, rounded to 3 decimals
meta.kept_cells: cells with built-up in at least one epoch (cells that are 0 in every epoch are dropped); land/water classification from ESA WorldCover 10 m v200 (2021) is used for the evidence test only
meta.land_mask: ESA WorldCover 10 m v200 (2021), CC BY 4.0 (ESA WorldCover 10 m v200, 2021), sampled at cell centre + 4 quarter points
caveats: GHSL misses much informal settlement; built fractions are lower bounds there
2020 is interpolated between observations (2018 observed), 2025 projected
1 km cells average over very different ground in a heterogeneous city
